title: GSE Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex zero-training readiness
purpose: Verify that one equivariant circular phase plus a positive closed K-gap simplex can jointly represent one-to-four executable exits and bind geometry/uncertainty without independent slot-localization freedom.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training readiness over C01-C08 metadata and eight deterministic real rows; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated autonomous best-method selection and requested continuous execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed COUST training and complex-cardinality attribution.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Audit all C01-C08 metadata and load eight deterministic real rows.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Re-audit every Teacher-source join and use the fixed eight real rows spanning cardinality one to four; no performance sampling.

teacher.source: Sealed 180-bin continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: Sensor-azimuth ordered targets enter only a cyclic-relabel invariant joint phase/gap loss; no identity enters model or loss.
teacher.valid_mask: Existing exact peak, independent width and global geometry masks unchanged.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only for eight real rows.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Prior frozen failures justify the representation change but no checkpoint is loaded.

methods.main: Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex: one phase distribution per cardinality, K positive normalized gaps closing at 360 degrees, cyclic-invariant continuous loss, geometry sampled at jointly decoded bearings and proper heteroscedastic phase/gap scales.
methods.baseline: COUST independent per-exit circular slots: K3 exact2 0.00240/0.00179 and non-transferable concentration; attribution excluded seed alignment and simple spacing collapse.
methods.fallback: If closure, rotation, cyclic invariance, collapsed-gap gradient, uncertainty likelihood or real finite backward fails, stop the candidate before training.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 188126 observations, 396913 peaks and fixed cardinality counts.
acceptance.joint_set: Every branch has strictly positive gaps summing to one and decoded wrap gaps recover the same closed circle.
acceptance.gradient: Collapsed K3 gaps have finite nonzero corrective gradient.
acceptance.uncertainty: Proper Laplace scale diagnostic is minimized at the known error magnitude.
acceptance.symmetry: Phase distribution rolls, gaps/scales stay invariant, bearings rotate and sampled geometry remains invariant within 3e-5.
acceptance.real_batch: Finite forward, joint loss and backward on eight real rows containing one through four exits.

failure_policy: Fail closed. Do not train, change Teacher, loosen symmetry, read test worlds or enter graph. PASS authorizes only a three-seed training Data Card.
retention: Retain summary, selected rows, figure/source, environment, log, RUN_STATE and seal; preserve prior failures as ablations.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU full metadata audit plus eight-row forward/backward
